investigation.whole_frame_refresh: All three shade arms exceed the 8.333 ms interval at 120 Hz: 10.217, 11.834 and 12.747 ms, versus the paired absent arm's 6.372 ms. Named pass measurements isolate cloud work rather than attributing the entire difference to it. These are sums of measured GPU pass durations, with capture off, while other builders share the machine; they are not presented cadence or qualified performance. The record retains the load before and after each paired campaign.
investigation.sun_pass_estimate: At 1x the three Sun passes total about 1.388 ms, above the design's unmeasured 0.1-0.2 ms estimate. The implemented profile stores 48/32/16 heights but integrates at <=40 m of path. At the noon direction this needs roughly 2/3/5 quadrature substeps per height interval, about 2.7 times the originally estimated density work on a full refill. True-Sun changes and anchor changes also request full refills; the maximum measured refill is 2.738 ms. Finer quadrature does not cure weather-grid reconstruction error, which is retained in M2-conformance.md. Coherent sampling, cadence and native kernel tuning remain work for the planned performance phase, without silently reducing fidelity here.
investigation.mean_reduction: The preliminary 64-lane reduction measured about 0.308-0.336 ms at the same 256-square outer product. Increasing the portable workgroup to 256 lanes reduces each lane's serial texture loop from 1024 reads to 256. This record measures 0.092-0.094 ms; the independent mean-transmittance oracle still passes under default limits. The source, look and host load also changed between records, so this is an observed component improvement, not a qualified whole-frame speedup.
investigation.memory_estimate: Actual texture payload is 32 MiB: 12 MiB weather (two RGBA32Float fields and one RGBA32Uint identity field), 12 MiB packed RGBA16Float Sun heights, and 8 MiB ground atlas. The 4 MiB weather and 2 MiB ground estimates did not account for these concrete formats and the integer conformance field. The f32 columns support the measured millimetre-level height conformance; RGBA16Float is a portable filterable storage format. Buffer payload is separately enumerated, including 16 KiB of integer/local-fraction axes uploaded only on anchor changes. No trace, layer, detail-noise volume or overlay is present. Driver/pipeline allocation overhead is outside payload counts.
